limitations: One first episode per engine; this is not a measured robustness probability.
Contact support and contiguous drift duration use held samples on the actual logged clock.
Near-rest sideslip is undefined and excluded below the fixed speed threshold.
Contact-patch slip must be recorded by each engine; it is never inferred from base velocity.
Canonical 50 Hz Isaac trajectory verifies actor observations; separately hash-verified physical-rate telemetry determines behavior and contact gates.
Legacy Isaac policy-rate records remain inspectable but unequal physical contact sampling is a failed paired gate.
Missing nonwheel contact telemetry leaves complete contact evidence false.
Common-window RMSE is diagnostic and uses no phase shift, spatial alignment or extrapolation.

task_profile.description: Trial010 adds only a smooth ground-normal wheel-load reserve penalty to original trial004, resuming its fixed final checkpoint. Sum exp(-max(F_ground_world_z,0)/(0.20*live_robot_weight)) over two separately ground-filtered wheels, reward weight -1. The force scale is not a minimum-load threshold. Sample the last actual5ms substep at the unchanged50Hz reward clock; no all-substep objective or observation change. Retain original500/10PD, old rewards, last-substep wheel-vz sampling, motor randomization, reference, friction, explicit MuJoCo contact response, clocks and every acceptance gate. Verify live mass/gravity and filtered normal-force GPU telemetry before learning. No forced50:50load, contact equivalence, hardware or statistical robustness claim.
